assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single game texture, 256 x 640 px, RGBA. Primary request: orthographic straight-on front face of a blank 1986 New Mexico roadside mile marker. The plate fills almost the entire 2:5 canvas, leaving transparent pixels outside the rounded silhouette. The central area x30..226,y60..580 in the intended 256x640 texture must be quiet, medium-dark green for code to overlay MILE and a large number. No pole, screws protruding, extra objects, letters, numbers, emblems, watermark or cast shadow. Genuine transparent background. One asset only, not a contact sheet.
